answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making identity a record of earned tenure rather than a name anyone can mint. A newcomer enters a wide canyon: nothing is given, so it must contribute verifiable work and be counter-signed by established peers before its vote carries any weight. Reputation grows like crystal, atom by attested atom, and it cannot be cloned in bulk; a comet of freshly created keys flashes past and leaves no trace behind. Because influence follows witnessed history instead of account count, a farm that spawns a thousand shells gets a thousand empty votes.
